title: Pika Generative AI Video and Animation Platform
summary: Pika is an advanced generative AI platform that creates high-quality videos and animations from text, images, and video prompts. It offers specialized tools for character consistency, lip-syncing, and physics-based effects.
research_notes: The platform focuses on cinematic quality and 'Pikaffects' for dynamic object transformations. It migrated its primary domain from pika.me to pika.art.

evolution.summary: Pika transitioned from a Discord-based beta to a robust web platform. It recently introduced the 'AI Self' feature, evolving the 'AI Selfie' tool into a monetization ecosystem where users earn revenue from their digital clones.
